verdict.rationale: Spline's in-editor AI covers asset generation: AI Textures creates texture images from text prompts, AI 3D Generation turns text or 2D images into models, and its AI Agents build scenes and screens from descriptions. None of these are the specific chores the story names beyond generation. The OpenAI API integration is a runtime interactivity feature, not an editor-side copy assistant. Missing for 10: background removal, content-aware fill, in-editor copy/text suggestions, general 2D image generation beyond textures, independent hands-on corroboration.
